text: {"answer": "The on-disk KB store (.tree-fs.json + .knowledge-base.yml) is owned by the Nuxt 3 web layer, whose kb-search-service.ts reads those files directly for zero backend load on the hot search path (writes go through Nuxt/Backend, reads are direct file access). The browser reaches FastAPI only through the Nuxt 3 Web UI acting as a proxy layer: browser fetch → Nuxt (dev 6789 / prod 3000) → server-to-server call with trust_env=False → FastAPI Backend + MinerU OCR (dev 8765 / prod 8001); the browser never contacts FastAPI directly.", "evidence_used": ["ARCHITECTURE"]}
